The edited image and all five valid, high-confidence traces consistently show the jacket hanging open with a clear gap, which is negative visual evidence—not a transport, schema, or dependency failure. However, the reference “yes” is an aggregate label, not atomic ground truth; do not force a pass or weaken the complete-closure requirement to match it. Since the instruction asks to close the jacket fully, distinguish no progress from partial progress if the image shows some closure but still a gap, and reserve unresolved for genuinely insufficient visibility. The traces report no such partial closure, so investigate the reference/aggregation or image pairing rather than changing the visual criterion to manufacture agreement.
